The file Harness loads is `lib/clien"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"t.bundle.js`, not the plain TypeScript emit."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"This package is a DeepSeek Harness **profile bundle**:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin into the composed loader tree.
2. The browser half waits fo"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"r `locale`, adds **繁體中文** to the Language menu, wraps `locale.translate` (the single path every boun"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"d `t` runs through), converts Simplified chrome to Traditional, and applies the Hong Kong phrase tab"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"le only when the active locale is `zh-Hant`.
3. Hardcoded English permission labels (`Read Only`, `W"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"orkspace Write`, `Full access`) are rewritten in the DOM, because those strings never go through the"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" locale service.
4. The browser loads `lib/client.bundle.js`, which registers through Harness `windo"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"w.__ModuleLoader__`. Plain `tsc` output cannot be served as the client entry.
5. Simplified Chinese "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"and English are unchanged."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"It does not fork the harness and does not rewrite every string by hand."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Other plugins"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Anything that renders through the locale service is covered automatically.** The `locale.translate"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"` wrap is service-wide: whether a plugin registers its own namespace and binds it at boot, or re-der"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ives `t` per render, its output is converted when 繁體中文 is active — including `t` functions another p"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"lugin captured *before* this plugin loaded (they call `this.translate` at call time, so the patch st"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ill catches them).
